experiences.name: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic multi-day trek to Annapurna Base Camp at 4,130m, passing through rhododendron forests, terraced fields, and traditional Gurung villages. Witness breathtaking panoramic views of Annapurna I, Machapuchare, and Hiunchuli peaks. This is the crown jewel of Himalayan trekking experiences.

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Viewpoint Hike
experiences.description: Rise before dawn and hike to Poon Hill at 3,210m for one of Nepal's most spectacular sunrises. Watch golden light illuminate the Dhaulagiri and Annapurna ranges in a stunning alpenglow display. The 2-hour ascent from Ghorepani is manageable and rewards trekkers with a 180-degree Himalayan panorama.

experiences.name: Gurung Village Cultural Homestay in Ghandruk
experiences.description: Spend a night in a traditional Gurung stone house in the hillside village of Ghandruk. Share home-cooked dal bhat with a local family, learn about Gurung customs and folklore, and explore the Ghandruk Eco Museum. This immersive cultural experience offers authentic insight into the indigenous mountain communities of the Annapurna region.

experiences.name: Modi Khola River Valley Nature Walk
experiences.description: Trek through the lush Modi Khola river valley, a biodiversity hotspot within the Annapurna Conservation Area. Spot rare Himalayan wildlife including langur monkeys, Himalayan tahr, and over 100 bird species including the danphe (Himalayan monal), Nepal's national bird. The trail winds through dense bamboo groves and cascading waterfalls.
experiences.location: Modi Khola Valley, Annapurna Conservation Area

experiences.name: Sarangkot Paragliding Launch & Phewa Lake Views
experiences.description: Hike up to Sarangkot hill at 1,592m for sweeping views of the Pokhara valley, Phewa Lake, and the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. Optionally launch a paragliding flight over the lake and city below. The hike itself is a rewarding nature walk through pine forests, and the viewpoint is one of the finest in the entire region.
